views.rationale: AMZN's sales increased 17% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period, while AAPL's segment operating performance was not mentioned.

AMZN's sales increased 17% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period, while BA's BCA segment revenues increased by $1,056 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026, compared with the same period in 2025.

CVX's Downstream net income in first quarter 2026 was a loss of $817 million compared with earnings of $325 million in the corresponding 2025 period, while BAC's sales and trading revenue increased by 13% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period.

CAT's Resource Industries' segment profit was $378 million in the first quarter of 2026, a decrease of $245 million, or 39 percent, compared with $623 million in the first quarter of 2025, primarily due to unfavorable manufacturing costs.
GOOGL's operating income rose 30% to $39.7 million, while GS's FICC intermediation net revenues fell 10%.
JNJ's sales to customers rose 10% to $24.1 billion, while KO's net operating revenues increased 12% to $12.5 billion.
JPM's net interest income rose 9% to $25.4 billion, while LIN's adjusted operating profit increased 8% to $2.6 billion.
NVDA's gross margin increased 14.4 percentage points year-over-year, compared to MSFT's 4% increase.
